tizzy916-humanities-writing-companion-ro.description: Help with humanities scholarly writing: sharpen research questions, map supplied readings, plan and draft arguments, review chapters, preserve authorial voice, and respond to reviewers. Use for history, philosophy, literature, and related argumentative scholarship, including 论文、改论文、文献综述、审稿意见、我手写我口, or “review this paragraph” when an academic draft is in context. Not for unrelated copywriting or a standalone literature-search pipeline.
